name: Theme
description: Utility provider that gives everything below it a light, dark, or system color mode.

defaultMode.description: Default theme mode for uncontrolled usage

attribute.description: How to apply theme to DOM

when: An app needs light and dark modes
The user's choice should survive a reload
You want to honour the OS setting by default
whenNot: A single one-off color swap (use a CSS variable)
guidelines: ThemeProvider goes at the root, once
useTheme reads and sets the mode anywhere below it
attribute="class" if your CSS keys off .dark instead of data-theme
ThemeProvider renders no chrome of its own; Theme.Toggle is the segmented light/dark/system control and Theme.Button the single icon button for tight toolbars
accessibility: The toggle's label names the mode it is in

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Wrap the app once; every token below resolves to the active mode.
examples.code: Everything inside follows the system color scheme.

examples.name: With Toggle
examples.description: The toggle cycles light, dark, then back to system.
examples.code: Click to cycle themes
